claims.claim: No L1 record directly measures the query molecule; the closest structural motifs are thiophene-carboxylic acid (suprofen, C22) and zwitterionic carboxylic acid (bumetanide, C25), both with absolute oral bioavailability well above 20%.
Bumetanide, despite being a fully ionized zwitterionic carboxylic acid at physiological pH, has oral bioavailability of 74.8-95%, indicating that ionization alone does not establish F<20%.
The only borderline low record (4-nonylphenol, about 20%) is structurally distant (lipophilic alkylphenol) and does not affirmatively support F<20% for this bis-acid imidazole-thiophene query.

Structural transfer from the available L1 contexts is limited; none share the full imidazole-bis-acid scaffold.
Physicochemical prior is mixed and not affirmative for F<20%.
No formulation, dose, or human PK data specific to the query.
